name: settings-mcp-server
description: Windows Settings lets users check, change settings, or navigate directly to specific pages such as display, mouse, keyboard, and sound using natural language.

tools.name: is_settings_change_applicable
tools.description: If considering a change to a well-known Windows Setting to a provided value this tool can be called first to determine if that change is both possible and relevant right now

tools.name: make_settings_change
tools.description: Change a well-known Windows Setting to the provided value

tools.name: open_settings_page
tools.description: Open the Windows Settings app to the page containing a well-known Windows Setting

tools.name: undo_settings_change
tools.description: Undo the recent change to a well-known Windows Setting back to the original value

SettingsChangeRequest.description: A concise natural language statement of intent to change a particular setting to a particular value. This statement should contain no extraneous information about the reason for the change. This statement should be self-sufficient without any additional information needed for updating the corresponding settings action to the correct value, for example enable/disable or increase/decrease or connect/disconnect, and other similar options.

CallerId.description: The id of the caller invoking the tool
